name: Database Primary Container Kill & Standby Promotion
prerequisites: postgres-primary (5432) active, postgres-standby (5433) streaming, backend connected.
execution_steps: docker kill postgres-primary
docker exec postgres-standby /usr/local/bin/promote-standby.sh
Update backend DATABASE_URL to port 5433 or route via internal VIP
Send POST /api/v1/scans/ to verify write operations succeed
expected_observation: Standby transitions to read-write in < 5s. Zero data loss. Backend recovers write queries.
disclosed_reason: Automated AWS staging cluster is not currently provisioned in this local development environment.

name: Frontend Container A Crash & Active Traffic Failover
prerequisites: frontend-a (3001) and frontend-b (3002) both healthy behind Nginx upstream frontend_cluster.
execution_steps: docker stop frontend-a
Execute 100 concurrent HTTP requests to http://ks-lb-01/
Inspect Nginx upstream response codes and latency
expected_observation: Nginx marks frontend-a down after 2 fails; 100% traffic routed to frontend-b. 0 HTTP 502 errors.
disclosed_reason: AWS EC2 instance ks-frontend-01 not provisioned locally.

name: Backend API Container A Kill & JWT Session Continuity
prerequisites: backend-a (8001) and backend-b (8002) active; valid JWT token issued.
execution_steps: Obtain JWT token from backend-a
docker kill backend-a
Send 50 authenticated requests with same JWT token to http://ks-lb-01/api/v1/assets
expected_observation: All requests routed to backend-b succeed with HTTP 200. Stateless JWT verification remains valid without re-login.
disclosed_reason: AWS EC2 instance ks-backend-01 not provisioned locally.

name: Worker A Mid-Execution Crash & Stale Job Reclamation
prerequisites: worker-a and worker-b polling PostgreSQL queue; job #999 in RUNNING status by worker-a.
execution_steps: docker kill worker-a mid-scan or report generation
Wait for STALE_JOB_TIMEOUT_MINUTES (or simulate timeout in test)
worker-b executes recover_stale_running_reports / recover_stale_running_scans
expected_observation: Stale job reclaimed by worker-b; status reset to PENDING and completed without duplicate record creation.
disclosed_reason: Distributed PostgreSQL worker pool not active locally.

name: Security Tools Agent A Failure & Warm Failover
prerequisites: tools-agent-a (9001) and tools-agent-b (9002) both healthy with Nmap installed.
execution_steps: docker stop tools-agent-a
Worker triggers authorized network scan via internal client
Client encounters connection error on 9001, fails over to 9002
expected_observation: Scan executes smoothly on tools-agent-b with full scope enforcement intact. Result stored in DB.
disclosed_reason: Tools agent cluster not provisioned locally.

name: Load Balancer Nginx Container A Crash & ALB Reroute
prerequisites: nginx-a (8081) and nginx-b (8082) registered as targets in AWS ALB target group.
execution_steps: docker kill nginx-a
ALB health check marks 8081 unhealthy after 2 consecutive failed probes (10s)
Continuously curl ALB public DNS
expected_observation: ALB shifts 100% ingress traffic to nginx-b (8082). Overall service availability maintained.
disclosed_reason: AWS ALB target group requires cloud VPC deployment.

name: High Concurrency Job Submission & Zero-Collision Claim
prerequisites: worker-a and worker-b active; PostgreSQL database connected.
execution_steps: Submit 10 scan jobs simultaneously via API
Both workers poll simultaneously every 1s using SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
Inspect execution log and database ScanJob table
expected_observation: Worker-a and worker-b each claim jobs without duplicate assignments or locking deadlocks. All 10 jobs reach COMPLETED.
disclosed_reason: AWS multi-worker pool not active locally.

name: Network Partition Between Hosts & Clean Failure Handling
execution_steps: Inject network latency / drop between ks-backend-01 and ks-db-01 via iptables
Observe backend connection pool timeout and CloudWatch alert firing
expected_observation: Backend returns HTTP 503 instead of hanging infinitely; CloudWatch triggers 'Backend 5xx > 1%' alert.
disclosed_reason: Multi-host cloud network not provisioned locally.
